//: The Deno-lane + browser-bundle config for the deltic host layer (the jco replacement).

MODULE-IDENTITY CONSTRAINT: deltic's wasi-shims and the polymorph deltic host modules import @deltic/runtime/embedder by bare specifier internally; this file maps that specifier ONCE for the whole module graph, so `instanceof WitError` holds across every boundary.

PINS: deltic is a git reference at .deps/deltic and the polymorph modules resolve into the pinned .deps/polymorph-iroh nested checkouts — scripts/setup.sh owns both pins and builds deltic's translator shim (justfile `_translator` prints its path).

MODULE-IDENTITY, second front: the sibling packages carry their own deno.json configs whose import maps pin @deltic/* to raw.githubusercontent URLs for STANDALONE use; Deno applies a package's own config to its files, so without the URL-prefix mappings below the graph (and the browser bundle) carried MULTIPLE deltic runtimes and `instanceof WitError` broke across the webcrypto/websocket boundaries (latent unbranded-throw traps). The prefix keys collapse every sibling-pinned deltic tree onto the local checkout; deno.lock must contain NO raw deltic URLs after `deno install` — when a sibling pin bump adds a new prefix, add it here (upstream convergence note in TASK.md).
The npm mappings serve the webrtc module's bare specifiers on the Deno lane; in-browser it uses stock RTCPeerConnection (the web bundle marks them external).
